en: A vintage black-and-white studio portrait of a woman standing and smiling at the camera with a cigarette in her mouth. She wears an elaborate period-style outfit with a patterned, quilted skirt and a fitted jacket with decorative buttons. The background is plain and dark, giving it a theatrical or promotional feel. In the upper left corner, white printed text identifies her and a role/title, and a small serial number appears in the lower left.
